lines.en: label tsuneyospring4:
scene spiter
scene black
The termite queen has tasked us with chewing through your deathbed.
lines.zh: 白蚁蚁后交给我们一项任务：啃穿你的临终之床。

lines.en: We’ll please her, lick her body clean, ensure we keep our young fed.
lines.zh: 我们会取悦她，把她的身体舔干净，确保我们的幼虫有饭吃。

lines.en: To starve and die a lonely death with dirt around us always,
lines.zh: 在泥土的环绕中，挨饿、孤独地死去，

lines.en: It feels a bit like heaven here. Or maybe just a hallway.
lines.zh: 这里感觉有点像天堂。或者也许只是一条走廊。

lines.en: scene colorbars
there is nothing more liminal than this
lines.zh: there is nothing more liminal than this

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd1
Tsuneyo Tojo glanced down at a tomato, recalling a story she once heard about how humans thought they were poisonous for a long fucking time until some wack job ate one and realized they weren’t.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 低头看着一颗番茄，想起她曾听过的一个故事：人类在很长一段时间里都以为番茄有毒，直到某个疯子吃了一个，才发现并非如此。

lines.en: Now, people eat tomatoes all the time. She wasn’t particularly a fan, though.
lines.zh: 如今，人们天天都在吃番茄。不过她自己并不怎么喜欢。

lines.en: Yes, they could be incorporated into several specific types of ramen, but she had yet to create or a discover a recipe in which they did not overpower everything else.
lines.zh: 是的，它们可以被加进几种特定的拉面里，但她至今没能创造或发现一种不让番茄盖过其他所有味道的配方。

lines.en: Today, she would try again. For there was no one here at all. No one here at all. It was just her and a tomato. It was her and a tomato and a knife. It was red. Like her nails. Like the hair of the ghost who raped her.
lines.zh: 今天，她要再试一次。因为这里一个人也没有。一个人也没有。只有她和一颗番茄。是她、一颗番茄和一把刀。它是红色的。像她的指甲。像那个强暴了她的女鬼的头发。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd2
Surely that was just a dream, though. And while it may have felt real, it defied all logic and happened between her and a dead woman.
lines.zh: 不过那肯定只是一场梦。虽说感觉很真实，但它完全违背逻辑，而且发生在她和一位死去的女人之间。

lines.en: It felt strange to her — wanting to experience that again. But it did feel new. And it made her want to try new things. Hence the tomato.
lines.zh: 对她来说这很奇怪——想要再经历一次那种事。但它确实感觉很新鲜。而且让她想去尝试新的事物。所以才有了这颗番茄。

lines.en: But Tsuneyo Tojo could not fuck a tomato, no. Not before marriage. And Tomato Tojo didn’t sound good. Nor did Tsuneyo Tomato. Actually, that one wasn’t that bad. But still, no.
lines.zh: 可 Tsuneyo Tojo 不能和一颗番茄交配，不行。婚前不行。而且 Tomato Tojo 听起来也不好。Tsuneyo Tomato 也不行。其实那个还凑合。但还是不行。

lines.en: : This is beginning to become a burden. Perhaps I should speak to a doctor?
lines.zh: : 这开始变成一种负担了。也许我该去看看医生？

lines.en: : I am a doctor.
lines.zh: : 我就是医生。

lines.en: : And now the tomato is speaking to me. How predictably unpredictable.
lines.zh: : 现在连番茄都在跟我说话了。真是可以预料到的不可预料。

lines.en: : What seems to be the problem, Ramen Girl?
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底有什么问题，拉面女孩？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd3
: Well, Mr. Mato, I’ve been experiencing strange hallucinations lately. Every day. And I’m hearing things too. Sometimes, both at once.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Mato 先生，我最近一直出现奇怪的幻觉。每天都有。而且我还会听到声音。有时候两者一起来。

lines.en: : But how does that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 但那让你有什么感觉？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd4

: I don’t feel much at all. But I believe it makes me crazy. And I worry about what will happen if I mention it to anyone else as I am already an exhibitionist. I do not wish to further burden those I care about.
lines.zh: : 我几乎什么感觉都没有。但我觉得这让我发疯。而且我担心如果跟别人提起会怎样，毕竟我已经是个暴露狂了。我不想再给我关心的人增加负担。

lines.en: : Do you enjoy being an exhibitionist?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢当暴露狂吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. Nor do I think I am very good at it as it only happened once and was entirely unintentional.
lines.zh: : 不怎么喜欢。而且我觉得自己也不太擅长，因为只发生过一次，而且完全是无意的。

lines.en: : Have you figured out why such a thing has happened yet?
lines.zh: : 你弄明白为什么会发生这种事了吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd1
: No...I have not. But I have an idea.
lines.zh: : 没有……还没有。不过我有个想法。

lines.en: : Why don’t you tell me all about it? No one else is here. You can pretend I’m any old customer.
lines.zh: : 为什么不跟我说说呢？这儿没有别人。你可以把我当成随便哪个老顾客。

lines.en: : This is meant to be a place for others to voice their worries to me. I will tarnish the sanctity of Tojo Ramen if I attempt to do the same.
lines.zh: : 这里本该是别人向我倾诉烦恼的地方。如果我也这么做，就会玷污 Tojo Ramen 的神圣。

lines.en: : Maintaining the “sanctity” of this place is important to you then?
lines.zh: : 那么，维护这里的“神圣”对你来说很重要？

lines.en: : It is my only duty. I would leave everyone and everything else behind for it if I needed to.
lines.zh: : 这是我唯一的职责。如果需要，我愿意为此把其他所有人和所有事都抛下。

lines.en: : Sounds pretty serious. Have you tried getting fucked?
lines.zh: : 听起来挺严重的。你试过被操吗？

lines.en: : That seems rather inappropriate for a tomato to say to a human. Let alone a doctor tomato.
lines.zh: : 一颗番茄对人类说这种话，未免太不合适了。更别说还是一颗医生番茄。

lines.en: : I just think you’d feel a lot better if you got fucked.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你要是被操了会舒服很多。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd5
: Just do it. You know for a fact that guy you’re interested in would help you out. And he’s already doing it with your friends.
lines.zh: : 去做就是了。你心里清楚，你感兴趣的那个男人会帮你的。而且他已经在和你的朋友们做了。

lines.en: : Why are you so scared, Ramen Girl? Just be more like them. That’s what they want. That’s what you want. And it would feel good too.
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么害怕，拉面女孩？就学学她们吧。那是她们想要的。也是你想要的。而且感觉也会很好。

lines.en: : I will not be tempted by a tomato. No matter how logical and blunt that tomato is.
lines.zh: : 我不会受一颗番茄的诱惑。不管那颗番茄多么有逻辑、多么直白。

lines.en: : It felt good, right? That dead lady’s fingers inside of you.
lines.zh: : 感觉很好吧？那个死掉女人插在你里面的手指。

lines.en: : Life is full of things that feel good. But feeling good alone doesn’t mean something is good for you.
lines.zh: : 世上让人感觉好的事情多了去了。但感觉好并不代表这件事对你有好处。

lines.en: : You mean like eating ramen?
lines.zh: : 你是说就像吃拉面一样？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd6
: That’s it. Prepare to die.
lines.zh: : 说得好。准备受死吧。

lines.en: : Mean-spirited tree girl! I have entered your working establishment.
lines.zh: : 坏心眼的树女孩！我进到你工作的地方来了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd7
: 二人で。
lines.zh: : 二人で。

lines.en: : Ah. Forgive me for not immediately noticing. Welcome to Tojo Ramen. You may seat yourselves. Please take a look at the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 啊。抱歉我没能立刻注意到。欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请随意入座。请看菜单，有任何问题都可以告诉我。

lines.en: : Understood. You’ve brought your own drawing equipment today and will not require mine. This saves me approximately 50 yen. I am eternally grateful.
lines.zh: : 明白了。今天你们自带了绘画工具，不需要我的。这为我省下大约 50 日元。我感激不尽。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd8
: Nao-chan has informed me that she visited this place with Friendburger Friendman and that you were very kind to her. I did not believe it.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 告诉我，她曾和 Friendburger Friendman 一起来过这里，而你对她非常好。我并不相信。

lines.en: : But I rejected this disbelief and decided that floppy wet breadstrips would give her a mouthsmile. Please do not turn her reverse-frown upside right.
lines.zh: : 但我抛弃了这份怀疑，决定让软塌塌的湿面条给她一个嘴角上扬。请不要把她那倒置的愁容再翻正过来。

lines.en: : Here at Tojo Ramen, we serve only the most mid-tier ingredients. Anything higher taints the authenticity of ramen. I can assure you that you will leave as satisfied as always.
lines.zh: : 在 Tojo Ramen，我们只使用最中档的食材。再高就会玷污拉面的本真。我向你保证，你们离开时一定会像往常一样满足。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd9
: Are you the only human who does the workjob in this house of soup?
lines.zh: : 在这座汤之屋里，做这份工作的只有你一个人吗？

lines.en: : That is correct. And again, we are not looking for assistance. But I thank you for your interest regardless.
lines.zh: : 没错。而且再说一次，我们不招人。不过还是感谢你的好意。

lines.en: scene black
: Now please, sit. I will not be able to live with myself if my customers are uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 那么请坐吧。如果我的客人不舒服，我会过意不去的。

lines.en: : Come, Nao-chan! Your book of colors will be more colorable upon this lengthy wooden noodlebed!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Nao-chan！在这张长长的木质面条床上，你的涂色本会变得更好涂！

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd10
: May I interest either of you two in a tomato free of charge?
lines.zh: : 二位有没有兴趣免费来一颗番茄？

lines.en: : Don’t you dare.
lines.zh: : 你敢。

lines.en: : What is “tomato?”
lines.zh: : “番茄”是什么？

lines.en: : Oh. You mean a savory nonapple. In what manner will its preparations be made?
lines.zh: : 哦。你是说咸味的非苹果。它要怎么烹制？

lines.en: : Any way you like. I just want an excuse to kill it.
lines.zh: : 随你喜欢。我只是想找个借口杀掉它。

lines.en: : The nonapple lives?
lines.zh: : 非苹果是活的？

lines.en: : And speaks as well?!
lines.zh: : 而且还会说话？！

lines.en: : She can hear it too?
lines.zh: : 她也能听到它说话？

lines.en: : Nao-chan believes the red sphere of flavor to be alive for some reason, yet none of its vibrations find my overcomplicated hearing orifices.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 出于某种原因相信这颗红色风味球体是活的，可它的任何振动都没有传到我这对过于复杂的听觉孔里。

lines.en: : Interesting. Has she recently hallucinated sexual intercourse with a ghost as well?
lines.zh: : 有意思。她最近也幻觉过和一个鬼做爱吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd11
: Have you, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Nao-chan？

lines.en: : It does not appear that she has.
lines.zh: : 看来她没有。

lines.en: : How unfortunate. It appears that I must continue to bask in uncertainty and unease then. Have you decided on your order yet?
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。看来我只能继续沐浴在不确定和不安之中了。你们决定好点什么了吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd12
: Tori shio ramen, multiplied by two to match the amount of bodies Nao-chan and I have combined.
lines.zh: : 盐味鸡肉拉面，乘以二，以匹配 Nao-chan 和我加起来的身体数量。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but that will not be possible today. My father is still unwell.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，今天恐怕做不了。我父亲仍卧病在床。

lines.en: : Then two servings of whichever soup contains the least amount of bugs.
lines.zh: : 那就来两份虫子含量最少的汤。

lines.en: : That would be all of them.
lines.zh: : 那全部都是。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd13
: What do you think, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Nao-chan？

lines.en: : I agree. And in regard to the nonapple?
lines.zh: : 我同意。那么非苹果呢？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd14

: House chashumen, multiplied by two to match the amount of bodies Nao-chan and I have combined. We will also have one clear cylinder of ocean blood and a less clear cylinder of maternal bovine juice.
lines.zh: : 本店叉烧面，乘以二，以匹配 Nao-chan 和我加起来的身体数量。我们还要一清筒海洋之血，以及一筒不太清的母牛汁液。

lines.en: : And one tomato, diced viciously into small cubes. Yes?
lines.zh: : 还要一颗番茄，恶狠狠地切成小块。对吧？

lines.en: : No. Nao-chan does not want to witness a death at the eating counter.
lines.zh: : 不。Nao-chan 不想在餐台前目睹一场死亡。

lines.en: : Thank you, little girl. Your name will go down in history once word of your good deed reaches the Eternal Vine.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，小姑娘。等你的善举传到永恒之藤那里，你的名字将被载入史册。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd15
: You will sleep out here once the shop has closed...and hopefully rot by morning’s first light.
lines.zh: : 等店铺打烊，你就睡在外头吧……希望你在清晨的第一缕光里烂掉。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. But this debatably fruitful vegetable has scorned me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。但这个算不算水果尚有争议的蔬菜侮辱了我。

lines.en: : There was no “scorn” at all. All I did was recommend a nice, healthy beef injection to ease the pain of growing up and all the terrible things that makes us feel. It’s an entirely human response.
lines.zh: : 根本没有什么“侮辱”。我只是推荐了一次优质健康的牛肉注射，来缓解成长以及成长带来的一切可怕感受所带来的痛苦。这是完全属于人类的反应。

lines.en: : Beef injection? Is that supposed to make the meat come quicker?
lines.zh: : 牛肉注射？那是为了让肉来得更快吗？

lines.en: : S-SEX?!?!
scene tsuneyidergzyafd16
: Why do you know more human terms than me all of a sudden?! I have been doing the practices for very long! I should be the smart one!
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然比我知道更多人类术语了？！我练习很久了！我才是聪明的那个！

lines.en: : Of course I have the embarrassment, Nao-chan! You should remember what happened on the hallowed ween!
lines.zh: : Nao-chan，我当然会尴尬！你应该还记得在那个神圣万圣节发生了什么！

lines.en: : No! You look like a nonapple! I look like a regular human female! Because that is what I am!
lines.zh: : 不！你才长得像非苹果！我长得像普通人类女性！因为我本来就是！

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: Something seems strange all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 突然有点不对劲。

lines.en: : If there is a certain topic or issue you wish to discuss to ease your mind, you may do so. Tojo Ramen is not just a house of soup, it is a house of secrets. And everything you say within these walls shall stay here forever.
lines.zh: : 如果有某个话题或问题你想聊一聊来放松心情，尽管说。Tojo Ramen 不只是一座汤之屋，也是一座秘密之屋。你们在这四壁之内说的一切，都将永远留在这里。

lines.en: : But...doing the talking will only make the shames bigger! Make your colors, Nao-chan! This is adultspeak!
lines.zh: : 可是……说出来只会让羞耻变得更大！去涂你的色吧，Nao-chan！这是大人谈话！

lines.en: : If you believe that talking will only deepen your issues, it is also fine to sit here in silence. Your dinner shall be ready momentarily. And in the event that you change your mind-
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得说出来只会让问题更深，那坐在这里保持沉默也完全可以。你们的晚餐马上就好。如果你改变主意的话——

lines.en: : I was a cat!
lines.zh: : 我是一只猫！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd18
: I went “nyaa nyaa” and licked my paws to clean my face...
lines.zh: : 我“喵喵”叫，还舔爪子洗脸……

lines.en: : I understand now why you were embarrassed to speak of this. I was unaware that you were such a dreadful pervert.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白你为什么不好意思说了。我不知道你竟是个如此可怕的变态。

lines.en: : That...That’s not...all, though...I...
lines.zh: : 那……那还不是……全部，不过……我……

lines.en: : I...did my first sex...
lines.zh: : 我……第一次做了爱……

lines.en: : With a ghost?
lines.zh: : 和鬼？

lines.en: : With a...human...a man...
lines.zh: : 和……人类……一个男人……

lines.en: : I see. One day, I will find someone to relate to.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。总有一天，我会找到一个能和我共鸣的人。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd19
: It felt...really good! I understand now why it’s such a common act between all species! But now my chest muscle goes DUNDUNDUNDUNDUN whenever the memory attacks my brain!
lines.zh: : 感觉……非常好！我现在明白为什么这是所有物种之间都如此普遍的行为了！但现在每当那段记忆袭击我的大脑，我的胸肌就会 DUNDUNDUNDUNDUN 地跳！

lines.en: : I can’t...stop thinking about it!
lines.zh: : 我……停不下来地想！

lines.en: : No! You take too long in the resting room!
lines.zh: : 不行！你在休息室待太久了！

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: I can understand your concerns and why you would feel this way.
lines.zh: : 我能理解你的担忧，以及你为什么会有这种感觉。

lines.en: : I, too, recently had my first sexual experience. And while it was not exactly what I imagined it would be, I’d be lying if I said I imagined much at all to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我最近也刚有了初次性体验。虽说它和我想象的不完全一样，但如果说我一开始就想象过多少，那我是在撒谎。

lines.en: : F-Finally! A relation I possess with the mean-spirited tree girl! She understands more than Nao-chan! She knows the pain! She wants kittens too!
lines.zh: : 终、终于！我和坏心眼的树女孩有了共鸣！她比 Nao-chan 更懂！她知道这种痛苦！她也想要小猫！

lines.en: : It’s a terrifying thing, isn’t it? To feel so much at once. I can understand now how one would get lost in it.
lines.zh: : 这是件很可怕的事，不是吗？一下子感受到那么多。我现在能理解，为什么会有人迷失其中。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd20
: If you do not mind me contributing to the conversation in a manner slightly above just listening, I’d like to mention my upbringing in an effort to connect and further relate. May I proceed?
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意我以略微超出“只是倾听”的方式参与这段对话，我想谈谈我的成长经历，以此建立联系、进一步共情。我可以继续吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Speak to me about your sex! I want to learn more!
lines.zh: : 好！跟我说说你的性！我想多学点！

lines.en: : If it’s about learning, I’m afraid I won’t be of much help. It wasn’t until recently that I’d learned about sex at all.
lines.zh: : 如果是为了学习，恐怕我帮不上什么忙。我也是直到最近才知道性这件事的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd17
: Growing up, my entire life was ramen. Cooking. How to procure and prepare ingredients. The knowledge of anything else seemed entirely unnecessary when this was always meant to be my life.
lines.zh: : 从小到大，我生活的全部就是拉面。烹饪。如何获取和料理食材。既然这本就该是我的一生，其他任何知识似乎都完全没有必要。

lines.en: : And while I’d known that animals reproduced via mating, I was left with only assumptions when it came to humans.
lines.zh: : 虽然我知道动物是通过交配繁殖的，可一涉及人类，我就只剩下猜测了。

lines.en: : I knew not of attraction...or what it meant to want someone on an instinctive level. But now that I do know, I am terrified. How can just wanting something feel so powerful?
lines.zh: : 我不懂吸引……也不懂在本能层面想要一个人意味着什么。可现在我懂了，我感到恐惧。为什么仅仅是想要某样东西，就能感觉如此强大？

lines.en: : Do you feel that same fear? Has experiencing it in reality amplified it? Or weakened it?
lines.zh: : 你也有同样的恐惧吗？在现实中经历过之后，它是被放大了，还是减弱了？

lines.en: : How can I make this go away?
lines.zh: : 我该怎么让它消失？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd21
: I would also like to know the answer to that question...
lines.zh: : 我也想知道那个问题的答案……

lines.en: : Doing the kiss move already made my lungs feel like they were full of bugs, but this is nineteen times worse.
lines.zh: : 做接吻动作的时候，我的肺就已经像塞满了虫子，可这比那还要糟十九倍。

lines.en: : It felt like I was...doing a bad thing. That it was too good to be a good thing. But now my human life is becoming strange and the me inside of me keeps telling me to do it more.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像我在……做一件坏事。好到不可能是好事。可现在我的类人生活变得奇怪起来，而我身体里的那个我一直在叫我要做更多。

lines.en: : Who is this “you inside of you” that you speak of?
lines.zh: : 你说的“你身体里的那个你”是谁？

lines.en: : It’s me, but not me. The words I have to explain it seem wrong.
lines.zh: : 是我，但又不是我。我用来解释它的词似乎都不对。

lines.en: : Does it force you to do things? Things you wouldn’t imagine otherwise? Things that seem powerful and right in the moment, but only because they are part of an illusion?
lines.zh: : 它会强迫你做事吗？那些你本来不会去想的事？那些在当下感觉强大而正确、却只因为它们是某种幻觉的一部分的事？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd22
: Yes! That is exactly the feeling! You are correct!
lines.zh: : 对！就是这个感觉！你说对了！

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd23
: Have they ever taken your clothes off and sent you outside to deliver a message to the sky and all who live beneath it?
lines.zh: : 它们有没有脱掉你的衣服，把你送到外面，向天空和所有生活在天空之下的人传递口信？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd24
: So specific! No! Mine just make me want to mate with Friend! Forever and ever and ever! And ever and ever and then longer after that!
lines.zh: : 这么具体！没有！我的那个只是让我想和 Friend 交配！永永远远！永远永远，然后再久一点！

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd25
: I see. Then perhaps the voices we hear are different. Especially if you were not able to catch the words of Tom Mato, MD.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那么我们听到的声音也许是不同的。尤其是如果你没能听清 Tom Mato 医生的话。

lines.en: : Perhaps! But-
lines.zh: : 也许！但是——

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd26
: Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : Nao-chan？

lines.en: : What is mattering?
lines.zh: : 到底怎么了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd27
: If she is concerned about the cleanliness of the broth vats, I can assure her that they are perfectly fine and have been boiling nonstop for decades now.
lines.zh: : 如果她是在担心汤锅的卫生，我可以向她保证它们完全没问题，而且已经不间断地沸腾了几十年了。

lines.en: : That doesn’t appear to be the mattering. She thinks that there’s something behind you.
lines.zh: : 看起来不是这件事。她说你背后有东西。

lines.en: : Yes. Those would be the broth vats. Which are perfectly clean and have been boiling nonstop for decades now.
lines.zh: : 是的。那些是汤锅。它们非常干净，而且已经不间断地沸腾了几十年了。

lines.en: : She says what’s behind you doesn’t involve soup at all. She calls him- what was the name again, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 她说你背后的东西跟汤一点关系都没有。她叫他——名字是什么来着，Nao-chan？

lines.en: : Tenchou-sama!
lines.zh: : 店长大人！

lines.en: : Tenchou-sama?
lines.zh: : 店长大人？

lines.en: scene tsuneyidergzyafd28
: But there’s nothing-
lines.zh: : 可是什么都没有——

lines.en: : Why is everyone moving so far away from me?!
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都离我那么远？！
